title: Gary Smith feat. Clark Gault - It Had to Be You

lines.l: Could make me be true, could make me be blue
And even be glad just to be sad thinking of you
Some others I've seen might never be me
Might never be cross, I try to be boss, but they wouldn't do
For nobody else gave me the thrill, with all your faults, I love you still
It had to be you, wonderful you, it had to be you
It had to be you, it had to be you
I wandered around and finally found
Somebody who could make me be true, could make me be blue
And even be quiet just to be sad thinking of you
Some mothers I've seen might never be me
Might never be cross, a try to be boss
But they wouldn't do
For nobody else gave me the thrill
With all your faults I love you still
It had to be you, wonderful you.
It had to be you.
Yeah baby, it had to be you.
Said by my window And they told me I don't need to agree
Summer came like cinnamon, so sweet Little grass double dutch on the concrete
